# Animation libraries

Local browser distributions; no runtime CDN or build step.

- Motion **14.11.1**: `package/dist/motion.js` from https://registry.npmjs.org/motion/-/motion-14.11.1.tgz
- Anime.js **4.5.0**: `package/dist/bundles/anime.umd.min.js` from https://registry.npmjs.org/animejs/-/animejs-4.5.0.tgz

Both are MIT licensed. License texts are retained alongside the distributions.
Versions were resolved from the npm stable `latest` tag on 2026-11-10.
